evidence: Bumps the minimum required GCC version to 13.1 in CMake and updates CI environment scripts across multiple platforms.
rationale: Bumping the minimum GCC version modernizes supported toolchains and unblocks codebase-wide adoption of C++20 std::format. As noted in the description, Bitcoin Core cannot currently use std::format or advance toward C++23 because supported compiler toolchains still include GCC 12.
